say.speaker: quiz_electric
say.text: {lord}! {partner}! {healer}! I ran all the way from the village. Don’t leave me out!

say.speaker: healer
say.text: The whole village crew, back together! Just in time, too. Morgrem’s gang is stripping the orchards.

say.speaker: raider_morgrem
say.text: Heh. These berries belong to Ironscale now. One Thunder Wave and you’ll be twitching in the grass.

say.speaker: mentor
say.text: Mind Morgrem’s lightning, everyone. And welcome back. Your sparks are just what we need.
